faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1.question: What are tokens and what are they for?
faq.q1.answer: Tokens are the application's virtual currency that allows students to make bookings. Each space or service has a token cost. Every month, they will be automatically renewed until you reach a maximum of 100 tokens.
faq.q2.question: How can I make a booking?
faq.q2.answer: To make a booking, go to the 'Bookings' section, select the desired space or service, choose the date and time, and click on configure. You will need to have enough tokens.
faq.q3.question: What happens if I cancel my booking?
faq.q3.answer: If you cancel your booking, the tokens used will be refunded so you can use them again in the future.
faq.q4.question: Why am I not receiving notifications?
faq.q4.answer: Make sure that notifications are enabled both in your device settings and within the app (Settings > Notification Preferences).
faq.q5.question: What is the difference between Spaces and Services?
faq.q5.answer: 'Spaces' are physical locations in the center, such as courts or classrooms. 'Services' are the facilities or resources available offered by the center to its students and teachers.
faq.q6.question: How do board announcements work?
faq.q6.answer: On the announcement board, you can see everything published by the high school.
faq.q7.question: Can I place cafeteria orders from the app?
faq.q7.answer: Currently, the cafeteria section serves to browse the products offered. It is not yet possible to process or pay for orders through the app. You can complete your transactions in person.
faq.q8.question: I have run out of tokens. What should I do?
faq.q8.answer: The total balance is automatically replenished every month. In case of strict necessity for teaching purposes, you may request an extraordinary top-up from the IES Luis Vives administrator.

iesinfo.sections.who.title: Who are we?
iesinfo.sections.who.subtitle: Mission, vision, goals, and quality commitments.
iesinfo.sections.who.description: IES Luis Vives is a public Secondary Education center located in northwest Leganés, specializing in Vocational Training. We offer morning and afternoon shifts with a wide range of programs and high employability.
iesinfo.who.mission.title: Mission
iesinfo.who.mission.content: To promote the educational, professional, personal, and emotional development of our students through innovative education based on core values.
iesinfo.who.vision.title: Vision
iesinfo.who.vision.content: To consolidate current teachings, explore new Vocational Training degrees, and be a community leader in innovation and cross-cutting projects.
iesinfo.who.objectives.title: General Objectives
iesinfo.who.objectives.items: Guarantee student integration into the labor market.
Promote effort and motivation as the basis for growth.
Apply continuous improvement in planning and evaluation.
Boost continuous training for teaching staff.
iesinfo.who.commitments.title: Quality Commitments
iesinfo.who.commitments.items: Response to inquiries/complaints in less than 48 school hours.
Annual inventory of over 300 companies for internships (FCT).
Job board offers communicated within a maximum of 2 school days.
Annual open house days for the Leganés community.
Book fund available for Basic Vocational Training students.
Solidarity food drive campaign during the first term.

faq.q9.question: How does the waiting list work?
faq.q9.answer: When a space is occupied at the time slot you want, you can join the waiting list. If a spot becomes available (due to a cancellation or rejection), you will receive an automatic notification so you can book it.
faq.q10.question: What are recurring bookings?
faq.q10.answer: Recurring bookings let you request a space on a regular basis (for example, every Tuesday). They require admin approval and automatically generate bookings based on the configured pattern.
faq.q11.question: How do I report an incident or fault?
faq.q11.answer: In the 'Settings' section you will find the option 'Report a problem'. Fill in the form with a description and, if possible, a photo. The school staff will receive the alert and handle it.
faq.q12.question: What are favourites for?
faq.q12.answer: Favourites let you save the spaces and services you use most often, so you can access them quickly from your profile without having to search every time.
faq.q13.question: How do polls work?
faq.q13.answer: The school occasionally publishes polls to gather opinions from students and teachers. When one is active you will receive a notification and can vote in the 'Polls' section of your profile.
faq.q14.question: Can I change my profile picture?
faq.q14.answer: Your profile picture is automatically synced from your Microsoft account. Change it via your school's Microsoft 365 portal and it will update in the app the next time you sign in.
